doc.brief: Determines what action the print operation should perform.
doc.md:
Determines what action the print operation should perform.

A parameter of this typs is passed to [`PrintOperation.run()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PrintOperation#method:run).

export.brief: Export to a file. This requires the export-filename property to be set.
export.md:
Export to a file. This requires
  the export-filename property to be set.

print.brief: Start to print without showing the print dialog, based on the current print settings, if possible.
print.md:
Start to print without showing
  the print dialog, based on the current print settings, if possible.
  Depending on the platform, a print dialog might appear anyway.
